subject: Scaling safeguard: premium response and onramp coordination
body:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@storix.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai; marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@storix.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion — premium SLA and throughput onramp

Hi Mateo / Marissa,

We're starting renewal planning for Storix's contract (current end: 2026-11-30) and want to discuss a path to a premium support tier tied to higher throughput and a tighter latency SLO for their high-volume inference pipelines. Key asks from our side:
- 99.9% availability SLA for their dedicated capacity pool during business hours (M-F 8am-8pm PT)
- 95th percentile latency target of <= 120ms for standard text-generation endpoints (aligned to their p95 distribution)
- A staged capacity onramp: +2x baseline for Q1 after renewal, +3x by end of Q2, with flexibility for burst for holiday spikes

They also asked about an onboarding credit or phased credit to offset migration/testing costs. Procurement is copied on this thread.

Can you share a sketch of options and a proposed timeline?

Thanks,
Jordan
Head of Platform, Storix

---
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@storix.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; monica_patel@redwood.ai; procure@storix.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — premium SLA and throughput onramp

Jordan — thanks for the clear asks. High level response so we can align internally before a call:

1) Premium SLA: we can offer a premium addendum that covers 99.9% uptime for the dedicated pool during the specified business hours plus an evergreen on-call escalation path. Outside business hours we can offer a lower uptime SLO or a paid on-call add-on.

2) Latency SLO: p95 <= 120ms is feasible for the curated model variant you run today; we'll need to lock sequence length profiles and typical batch sizes to guarantee this. If the workload shifts to longer sequences or higher concurrency, we should model the p95 tail and include a performance collar in the addendum.

3) Capacity onramp: propose a three-step onramp with capacity reservations and an auto-burst allowance. Suggest: Q1 reserve +100% baseline, Q2 reserve +200%, with an option to increase burst pool +50% for up to 48hrs with notice.

4) Credits: we typically provide a one-time onboarding credit for migrations tied to a 12-month renewal commitment. I can propose numbers once we have expected token/throughput profiles.

Can Marissa and Monica weigh in on comms, ops, and credit sizing? If acceptable, let's schedule a 30-minute architecture + procurement call later this week.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai; Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@storix.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai; procure@storix.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 13:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — premium SLA and throughput onramp

Jordan / team,

Operational notes:
- We'll need Storix to provide a 7-day sample of peak-hour traffic (token/sec + concurrency) and a representative prompt/sequence-length distribution so our SREs can simulate p95 under the proposed reserve sizes. Please attach the anonymized sample when you can.
- For the latency collar, recommend we define a "performance guardrail" clause: if p95 degrades >20% vs. baseline for two consecutive weeks, both sides run a joint triage and we trigger capacity/optimization credits rather than immediate SLA crediting.
- On onboarding credits: typical structure is a one-time credit equal to 10% of first-quarter committed spend; for larger multi-quarter commitments we scale to 15%. This is negotiable in the commercial terms.

I'll prepare a draft SLA addendum and ops runbook (attachment) and circulate for redline. Proposed call slots: Wed 10/07 10:00-11:00 PT or Thu 10/08 14:00-15:00 PT.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_sla_addendum_v2.pdf (14KB)

---
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@storix.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@storix.ai; monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — premium SLA and throughput onramp

Thanks Marissa — that all sounds reasonable. We can extract a 10-day anonymized sample this week; procurement asked whether the onboarding credit can be front-loaded against Q1 committed spend rather than applied as a bill credit. Also: Storix legal wants the performance guardrail wording to explicitly exclude customer-side load misconfiguration causes.

Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept a technical exception carve-out for customer misconfig that absolves SLA crediting? If so, we'll prepare the sample and lock a slot for Wed 10/07 10:00 PT.

Jordan

---
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@storix.ai>; mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai; marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@storix.ai
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — premium SLA and throughput onramp

Jordan — quick clarifications prior to the call:
- We can accept a customer-misconfig carve-out in the SLA addendum; the clause needs objective tests (e.g., request rate vs. agreed concurrency cap, malformed payload ratios, or invalid auth patterns) so it isn't used as a blanket exclusion.
- Onboarding credit: we can front-load the credit as a pre-paid offset applied to the first invoice after renewal if the commercial team signs a 12-month committed spend clause. We'll note both options in the commercial redline.
- Action items for Storix before the Wed 10/07 10:00 PT call: provide the 7-10 day anonymized peak sample, confirm baseline model/variant and typical seq lengths, and indicate whether they want the burst pool to be auto-triggered or manual-request.

I'll post the ops runbook and the updated SLA addendum (v2 with carve-out language) to the HubSpot deal and include the DocuSign draft for signatures after we align on the technical collar.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.
Monica Patel
Senior Manager, Solutions Architecture
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced in thread: Storix_Q42027_usage_report.csv (CSV stub), proposed_sla_addendum_v2.pdf (14KB)

---
Notes: Call confirmed for Wed 2026-10-07 10:00-10:30 PT. HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345. DocuSign room created: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/ABC-45678
